verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page claims you can 'Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks' (glama-docs-10), which directly names scheduled workflows. That one line is the only evidence; there are no docs on how schedules are defined, what can be triggered, or what recurrence options exist. Missing for 10: dedicated scheduling documentation, recurrence/cron configuration details, the scope of schedulable jobs (MCP tool calls, agent runs, chats), and independent or hands-on confirmation.
